policy: Citing a fact from a public primary or government document and linking to it is ordinary attribution, and does not pass through the source-terms gate that governs commercial price and data feeds: that gate exists because those feeds' values are redistributed, and a facility citation redistributes nothing. Every source domain in the research package is therefore clear by class unless it appears below. See docs/methodology/map-facilities.md section 4.

states.verify_access: The claim originates behind a paywall, so a reader following the link may not be able to check it. A person should confirm the same fact against a primary source, or accept the record as corroborated-only.
states.prefer_primary: A third-party republication of a document that has a primary home. Re-cite the primary.
states.review_required: Urdais's intended use of this source raises a question a person must answer before the claim is relied on.
